name: intraday-equities-mio-demo
notes: UNCALIBRATED DEMO — synthetic data only, never wired to live/paper trading (ADR-0111, docs/plans/2026-09-intraday-equities-mio.md). Mirrors examples/pipeline/pyomo-solve.json's three-node shape: a deterministic toy source (intraday_equities.testing:SyntheticMioSource) emits per-instrument cluster evidence for the owned stat_test gate plus a synthetic forecast bundle and portfolio state; the stat_test decides which of AAPL/MSFT/XOM survive (all three, by construction — the source's edge is unambiguous); EquityKellyMIO then sizes only the survivors under the scenario-utility MILP (dskit/pipeline/libs/pyomo.py:ScenarioUtilitySolve). The risk knobs below are the design plan's own illustrative reference values (§4/§12), not calibrated against any realized data — swap the source node for a real forecast-bundle producer and replace every risk knob with an owner-approved number before this touches real capital.

source.notes: role data. NOT real market data — three names with a clear, deterministic positive edge, reproducible across runs. Swap this node for a real bundle producer to make the document real.

edge_test.notes: role stat_test, toolkit-OWNED. One-sided event-clustered bootstrap per instrument, then one BH correction across the family. All three survivors are expected here — the source's evidence is unambiguous by construction.

size.notes: role capital. The survivors wire is structural: un-gated capital refuses to plan. Every risk knob here is the plan's own illustrative reference value (docs/plans/2026-09-intraday-equities-mio.md §4/§12) — an owner decision for any real run, never a code default (ScenarioUtilitySolve/EquityKellyMIO refuse to construct without one).
